segments.sn6.6:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
segments.sn6.6:1.3: Atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ [paccekadvārabāhaṃ (pī. ka.)] upanissāya aṭṭhaṃsu. Atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā suddhāvāsaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn6.6:1.6: Asuko ca brahmaloko iddho ceva phīto ca, brahmā ca tatra pamādavihāraṃ viharati.
segments.sn6.6:1.7: Āyāma, mārisa, yena so brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejeyyāmā”ti.
segments.sn6.6:1.8: “Evaṃ, mārisā”ti kho suddhāvāso paccekabrahmā subrahmuno paccekabrahmuno paccassosi.
segments.sn6.6:2.1: Atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso…pe… evameva – bhagavato purato antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
segments.sn6.6:2.2: Addasā kho so brahmā te brahmāno dūratova āgacchante. Disvāna te brahmāno etadavoca –
segments.sn6.6:2.4: “Āgatā kho mayaṃ, mārisa, amha tassa bhagavato santikā arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segments.sn6.6:2.5: Gaccheyyāsi pana tvaṃ, mārisa, tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā”ti?
segments.sn6.6:3.1: Evaṃ vutto [evaṃ vutte (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] kho so brahmā taṃ vacanaṃ anadhivāsento sahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn6.6:3.2: “passasi me no tvaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāva”nti?
segments.sn6.6:3.4: “So khvāhaṃ, mārisa, evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo kassa aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmī”ti?
segments.sn6.6:4.1: Atha kho subrahmā paccekabrahmā dvisahassakkhattuṃ attānaṃ abhinimminitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn6.6:4.2: “passasi me no tvaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddhānubhāva”nti?
segments.sn6.6:4.4: “Tayā ca kho, mārisa, mayā ca sveva bhagavā mahiddhikataro ceva mahānubhāvataro ca.
segments.sn6.6:4.5: Gaccheyyāsi tvaṃ, mārisa, tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā”ti?
segments.sn6.6:4.6: Atha kho so brahmā subrahmānaṃ paccekabrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn6.6:5.3: Tayidaṃ vimānaṃ jalate ca [jalateva (pī. ka.)] brahme,
segments.sn6.6:7.1: Atha kho subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejetvā tatthevantaradhāyiṃsu.
segments.sn6.6:7.2: Agamāsi ca kho so brahmā aparena samayena bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti. 7.

lines: Chaṭṭhe paccekaṃ dvārabāhanti ekeko ekekaṃ dvārabāhaṃ nissāya dvārapālā viya aṭṭhaṃsu.
Etadavocāti etesaṃ nimmitabrahmānaṃ majjhe nisinno etaṃ “passasi me”tiādivacanaṃ avoca.
Tayo supaṇṇāti gāthāya pañcasatāti satapadaṃ rūpavasena vā pantivasena vā yojetabbaṃ.
Bugghīnisā pañcasatāti byagghasadisā ekacce migā byagghīnisā nāma, tesaṃ byagghīnisārūpakānaṃ pañcasatāni, pantivasena tayo supaṇṇāti tīṇi supaṇṇapantisatāni, caturo haṃsāti cattāri haṃsapantisatāni.
Jhāyinoti jhāyissa mayhaṃ vimāne ayaṃ vibhūtīti dasseti.
Uttarassaṃ disāyanti taṃ kira kanakavimānaṃ tesaṃ mahābrahmānaṃ ṭhitaṭṭhānato uttaradisāyaṃ hoti.
Ayaṃ panassa adhippāyo – evarūpe kanakavimāne vasanto ahaṃ kassa aññassa upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmīti.
Rūpe raṇaṃ disvāti rūpamhi jātijarābhaṅgasaṅkhātaṃ dosaṃ disvā.
Sadā pavedhitanti sītādīhi ca niccaṃ pavedhitaṃ calitaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ rūpaṃ disvā.
Tasmā na rūpe ramati sumedhoti yasmā rūpe raṇaṃ passati, sadā pavedhitañca rūpaṃ passati, tasmā sumedho sundarapañño so satthā rūpe na ramatīti.
Tesu hi eko paccekabrahmā gandhakuṭiyā ekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya ṭhito, aparo aññaṃ.
Paccekabrahmāti ca ekacārī brahmā, na parisacārī brahmāti attho.
Samiddhi nāma sagge sukhupakaraṇehi, brahmānañca jhānaṃ sukhupakaraṇanti jhānasukhena samiddhoti.
Sampattiyā vepullappattatā brahmānañca abhiññāguṇehi vepullappattīti āha “phītoti abhiññāpupphehi supupphito”ti.
Ekacceti eke migārī, tesaṃ byagghīnisārūpakānaṃ pañcasatānīti attho.
“Kassa aññassa upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmī”ti vimānasampattiyaṃ vimhayakkhiko ahaṅkāravasena vadati.
Virodhipaccayasannipāte vikāruppatti ruppanaṃ rūpassa pavedhananti āha “sītādīhi ca niccaṃ pavedhita”nti.
Sumedho sundarapañño so satthā rūpe na ramati, kiṃ pana mandapañño rūpe saraṇañca pavedhitañca apassanto ramasīti adhippāyo.
